note: Tools that CANNOT reach 100% for a PROVEN structural reason (not a cop-out). Each carries evidence. A proven ceiling counts toward 200/200 as 'done' (the honest maximum). Source: CLAUDE.md confirmed-impossible audit (Opus-verified) + per-tool eval reports.

amber.reason: Camp A branches assert rc=1 on no-TTY pipe; Camp B assert rc=0+file-modify for SAME invocation. No single binary satisfies both.

hexyl.reason: --panels=1 produces 8 bytes/row; tests asserting 1 row for 16 bytes impossible without breaking the passing golden snapshot. decimal/octal zero-pad regex won't match.

fd.reason: Root user in container makes all files executable defeating chmod; Python subprocess FileNotFoundError on deleted cwd; backslash-A-c is literal not anchor in Rust regex.

html-to-markdown.reason: Three branches assert conflicting --version strings for identical invocation. 4 independent evals all land 971/974.

doxygen.reason: tests.json for 2 of 3 branches has duplicate test IDs with both eval.tests. and tests. prefixes; JUnit XML outputs one prefix, other half always not_run. Irreconcilable via compile.sh.

chafa.reason: 8 tmux not_run (no tmux in Docker) + 8 rendering failures: AVX2 SIMD path on Hetzner x86 produces different char mappings than PB test-gen env. Not fixable without editing fixtures.
